messages:
Maya Patel: Quick q — FinOps asked for a spot savings breakdown for Q2. Can we get a unit-econ view and a forecast model? Looking at GPU pool (A100s) across us-central/us-west. baseline: on-demand $3.06/hr, average spot $0.92/hr, spot eviction rate ~12% daily. Need per-team chargeback suggestions.
Sam Liu: rough calc: if p_spot=0.88 effective (1-eviction), expected unit cost = 0.88*0.92 + 0.12*(3.06+overhead) — I can run MonteCarlo to be precise. :thinking: 
Priya Reddy: For chargeback, suggest we show both raw savings and uncertainty. Teams get credited expected savings but we keep a 'variance buffer' pool to cover reclaims (e.g., 10% of savings into ops reserve).
Carlos Gomez: Agree. Also recommend mixed-capacity pools: reserve ~20% on-demand/dedicated for latency-sensitive, rest spot for batch/async. Keeps tail SLOs and reduces emergency on-demand spikes.
Jules: @Maya @Sam can you share eviction distribution by region? Variance differs a lot between us-west and us-central for the last 90d.
finops-bot: daily-spot-stats report uploaded: /reports/spot-evictions-90d.csv (avg eviction: us-central 9.8%, us-west 15.2%, ap-south 22%)
Sam Liu: grabbing the CSV. Quick MonteCarlo prototype: 
```
# run 100k sims
expected_cost = p_spot*spot + (1-p_spot)*(on_demand + preemption_recover_cost)
```
Sam Liu: Early sims show mean savings ~64% vs on-demand but std dev ~8% of cost — sizable. Tail risk when ap-south usage spikes or when baseline on-demand increases.
Priya Reddy: For chargeback I'd present 3 lines: conservative (savings - buffer), expected, optimistic. Use 30d rolling avg for p_spot and cap refunds to avoid negative ops balance.
Maya Patel: Good. Any ideas for forecasting improvement? We need to predict p_spot per region per hour (for monthly chargeback).
Carlos Gomez: We can build a simple GLM or lightgbm with features: region, hour-of-day, cluster-utilization, recent eviction trend. Also operational levers: bidding strategy, instance diversification (gpus + gpus-alt).
Jules: I'll prep a short deck with MonteCarlo outputs, recommended buffers, and a proposed chargeback cadence. @finops-bot can you attach per-team historical consumption by pool?
finops-bot: attached /exports/team-usage-by-pool-2025Q1.csv :thumbsup: 
Maya Patel: Thanks all — aim to have draft to FinOps by EOD Friday. :calendar:
